This repo collects case studies evaluating the [Bridge2AI Talent Knowledge Graph](https://github.com/jiaweixu98/bridge2aikg)
(KG) — built and maintained separately from this repo — against concrete use cases:
mentorship sourcing, interdisciplinary grant team formation, and cross-disciplinary
niche mapping. The goal is to determine what the existing KG query capabilities support
today, and what gaps remain.

## Attribution

Case studies authored by Monica Munoz-Torres and Janani Ravi.
